newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell sharply to 0.95 million yuan from 2.1 billion yuan on Tuesday.
A rumour that the People's Bank would cut bank interest rates in the first quarter of 1997 reduced buying pressure, traders said.
They said some short-term financial centres did not trade today, which also made trading dull.
"Trading volume is likely to expand in the next few days when those financial centres begin to trade," one trader said.
"Demand for funds by some financial institutions since mid-December has encouraged trading in the 60-day contract and made it the most active one today," a second trader said.
